hints.content: The areas of the top and the base are simply the area of a circle: $\pi r^2 = \pi \cdot 3^2 = 9 \pi$.
The lateral surface area is the same as the area of a rectangle with height $8$ and width equal to the circumference of the base.
Thus, the lateral surface area is $wh = 6 \pi \cdot 8 = 48 \pi$.
The total surface area is $9 \pi + 9 \pi + 48 \pi = 66\pi$ square units.
